story.text: 승객 여러분, 이제 서울에서 가장 활기찬 거리들로 향합니다. 쇼핑과 젊음의 에너지를 느껴보세요!
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-je seo-ul-e-seo ga-jang hwal-gi-chan geo-ri-deul-lo hyang-ham-ni-da.
story.en: Passengers, we're now heading to Seoul's most vibrant streets. Feel the energy of shopping and youth!

story.text: 먼저 '명동'이에요. 화장품 가게부터 길거리 음식까지, 쇼핑의 모든 것이 모여 있어요.
story.reading: meon-jeo myeong-dong-i-e-yo. hwa-jang-pum ga-ge-bu-teo gil-geo-ri eum-sik-kka-ji, syo-ping-ui mo-deun geos-i mo-yeo i-sseo-yo.
story.en: First is 'Myeongdong'. From cosmetics shops to street food, everything about shopping is gathered here.

story.text: 그리고 '홍대'! 젊음의 거리답게 개성 넘치는 카페와 클럽들이 밤새 불을 밝혀요.
story.reading: geu-ri-go hong-dae! jeol-meum-ui geo-ri-dap-ge gae-seong neom-chi-neun ka-pe-wa keul-leop-deul-i bam-sae bul-eul bal-kyeo-yo.
story.en: And 'Hongdae'! True to being the street of youth, unique cafés and clubs light up all night long.

story.text: 명동의 '화장품' 가게들은 관광객들에게 특히 인기가 많아요. 직원분들이 여러 언어로 안내해주시죠.
story.reading: myeong-dong-ui hwa-jang-pum ga-ge-deul-eun gwan-gwang-gaek-deul-e-ge teuk-hi in-gi-ga man-a-yo.
story.en: Myeongdong's 'cosmetics' shops are especially popular with tourists. Staff often assist in multiple languages.

story.text: 홍대에서는 길거리 '버스킹'을 자주 볼 수 있어요. 재능 있는 아티스트들의 무대죠.
story.reading: hong-dae-e-seo-neun gil-geo-ri beo-seu-king-eul ja-ju bol su i-sseo-yo.
story.en: In Hongdae, you can often see street 'busking'. It's a stage for talented artists.

story.text: 이 두 거리를 보면 요즘 서울의 '유행'이 어디로 향하는지 알 수 있어요.
story.reading: i du geo-ri-reul bo-myeon yo-jeum seo-ul-ui yu-haeng-i eo-di-ro hyang-ha-neun-ji al su i-sseo-yo.
story.en: Looking at these two streets, you can tell where Seoul's current 'trend' is heading.

story.text: 쇼핑도 하고 공연도 보고, 정말 알찬 하루였죠? 오늘 배운 단어로 문제를 풀어볼게요!
story.reading: syo-ping-do ha-go gong-yeon-do bo-go, jeong-mal al-chan ha-ru-yeot-jyo?
story.en: Shopping and shows all in one — quite a full day, right? Let's solve some questions with today's words!

words.example_en: Myeongdong is the center of shopping.
Hongdae is famous as the street of youth.

words.example: 이 화장품 가게는 정말 인기가 많아요.
words.example_reading: i hwa-jang-pum ga-ge-neun jeong-mal in-gi-ga man-a-yo
words.example_en: This cosmetics shop is really popular.

words.example: 홍대에서 버스킹 공연을 볼 수 있어요.
words.example_reading: hong-dae-e-seo beo-seu-king gong-yeon-eul bol su i-sseo-yo
words.example_en: You can watch busking performances in Hongdae.
What style is trending these days?

sentences.en: I looked around at various cosmetics in Myeongdong.
Hongdae's streets are lively even at night.
The cosmetics shop staff kindly explains the products.
Many people gather to watch the busking performance.
Many trend-conscious young people gather here.
